feature: Distributed ordinary AR capture retirement and recovery under native KV exhaustion
production_change: None; existing scheduler, capture lifecycle and Store paths run unchanged.

jobs.diagnostic: The v1 fixture required four requests in one batch. Native PP split them across microbatches. v2 explicitly uses two-request PP microbatches and requires four simultaneous capture contexts plus replay at both two and one requests.

limitations: BF16 Qwen3-0.6B, Triton attention, TCP Mooncake Store and HTTP TestCaptureCatalog on H100.
PP uses synchronous scheduling and two-request microbatches. Prefill graphs are disabled.
KV and teacher use 16-token D2H staging. A serving logit bias makes token paths deterministic.
Native KV pool exhaustion is tested; CUDA allocation failures, device faults and saturated Store/Catalog backpressure are separate.
Synchronous source-pool/logit observers validate preservation, not independent attention math or serving SLOs.
Distributed P/D AR pressure, cross-node RDMA, other models/topologies, production retention and trained draft quality remain outside this matrix.
